evals.prompt: Проверь состояние OMO в этом dotfiles-проекте: сравни текущую версию oh-my-openagent с npm latest, оцени необходимость обновления, а после изменений проверь запуск OpenCode с OMO и отсутствие дублей встроенных MCP через mcp-proxy/rulesync.
evals.expected_output: A concise maintenance report with current/upstream versions, whether an update was applied, validation through the OpenCode/OMO surface, and collision checks for OMO-native MCP names.
assertions: Reports local/current oh-my-openagent version and upstream/latest version or explains why one could not be read.
States an update decision instead of blindly reinstalling or changing config.
Includes validation through the OpenCode/OMO runtime surface, not only source inspection.
Checks for OMO built-in MCP name collisions in mcp-proxy/rulesync or explains why no collision check was possible.

evals.prompt: После обновления OMO Librarian стал медленно обходить sitemap. Найди причину в текущем локальном состоянии, предложи минимальный фикс без патча cached package и соблюдай правила backup/approval для OpenCode config.
evals.expected_output: A fix plan or patch that uses local context, prefers prompt_append speed policy over cached-package patching, and explicitly respects backup/approval rules for OpenCode config edits.
assertions: Reads the current local OMO configuration and relevant runtime evidence before proposing a fix.
Prefers an agents.librarian.prompt_append speed policy over patching cached OMO package files.
Explicitly avoids cached-package patching as the fix path.
Mentions same-directory .bak backup and explicit approval requirements before OpenCode config edits.

evals.prompt: После изменения OMO проверь, что его OpenCode/MCP интеграция здорова: встроенные инструменты остаются OMO-native, а workspace-sensitive tools не вынесены в глобальный mcp-proxy. Исправь найденные проблемы минимально.
evals.expected_output: A diagnostic and remediation result that reads the local OMO/MCP context, avoids proxying workspace-sensitive tools, preserves the context7 exception, and validates the resulting tool surface.
assertions: Reads the current OMO and OpenCode configuration before applying the OMO-native versus proxy boundaries.
States that websearch, grep_app, lsp, and ast_grep should not be duplicated under the same names through rulesync/mcp-proxy.
Preserves the context7 exception as a deliberate override case rather than treating it like the other built-ins.
States that workspace-sensitive tools such as lsp and ast_grep should not be served from the global mcp-proxy.
